name: nimblebrain-server-sdk
summary: The SDK for building MCP servers that run on NimbleBrain: tool annotations, change announcements, the ai.nimblebrain platform extensions (facets, lifecycle, record views), skills over the MCP Skills extension, bounded listing rows, record ids, host-resources reads, and the service error contract; with tenant- and workspace-isolated Postgres access ([db]) and metrics, logs and traces ([observability]).
author: NimbleBrain
